scientific_limitations: Complete distributions are proved only for d,t>=2 with a=dt+1 and b=a+d, not for arbitrary coprime generators.
The symmetric-semigroup and semigroup-polynomial identities are previously known.
Priority comparison covers inspected relevant full texts and targeted searches but cannot exclude an older implicit equivalent coefficient-word calculation.
Finite exact-integer checks corroborate the unrestricted argument but do not independently prove it.
title: Exact run-length frequencies for binary semigroups with \(a=dt+1\) and \(b=a+d\)
